docs.title: GOAL.md
docs.text: Who it is for Small teams that send invoices every week and want it to take minutes, not an afternoon. The goal Ready for the first paying teams. Clarity and speed first. G1 New teams sign up and send their first invoice. G2 A first import runs end to end. G3 Every screen fits a phone. G4 Feedback reaches the queue the same day. G5 Install from the app store. How it looks and feels Calm, light, precise. One accent; status as a dot and a word. How it speaks Plain words. Outcomes, never machinery.
